howto: Drag your finger, move the mouse or hold the arrow keys: the diver swims after it.
You rise towards the surface on your own, 100 m to go. Swimming higher on the screen climbs faster.
Jellyfish drift down past you. Touching one stings you.
Reach 0 m to escape before you run out of hearts.
tips: High on the screen climbs fastest but gives you less warning.
Jellyfish sway from side to side as they sink, so leave room.
After a sting you blink for a moment and cannot be stung again.
More jellyfish appear the closer you get to the surface.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys swim; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag and the diver follows your finger. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy gives 3 hearts and fewer jellyfish; Normal 2 hearts; Hard 1 heart and more jellyfish.

cheats.effect: 3 extra stings before the run ends
The diver shrinks to half size

features.one-tap-start: Tap, Space or an arrow key on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the STUNG! or SURFACE! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST metres climbed under the hearts
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated drag; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: STUNG! card with metres climbed and best, or SURFACE!
